blind.description: A freestanding modular section of straight ashlar stone wall. It consists of multiple horizontal courses of rectangular sandstone-style blocks topped with a rounded coping or cornice trim. The surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled with stylized block crevices. The bottom sits directly flat on the ground without an added plinth or base slab. Painted in warm tan, beige, and light yellow-brown temple stone tones.
blind.from_above: A narrow beige rectangle with slightly rounded edges, representing the top coping stone of the wall.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7.5 to 8 ft tall (roughly 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 to 5 ft wide.
